description: Bio-safety hazard signature stub for AeonScript v0.1. This is a placeholder demonstrating the API contract. The signatures below are SYNTHETIC test patterns, NOT real pathogen sequences. A v0.2 production engine should integrate against the IGSC Harmonized Screening Protocol or an equivalent international service.
notes: Real hazard databases (IGSC, Twist, IDT internal lists) are not publicly distributable.
These signatures are deliberately benign test patterns to exercise the screening pipeline.
Production conformance requires BLAST-grade similarity matching at >= 90% identity over >= 20 bp.
